A tan hand with short-trimmed nails reaches out to grip the black padded handle firmly, ready to begin an exercise. The background is a blurred gym interior with industrial piping and bright overhead lights. (2) The camera pans out and zooms to show a man with dyed blonde hair wearing a large black hoodie performing a seated rowing motion. He pulls the weight toward him, his facial expression shifting from a look of concentration to a broad, joyful smile. Behind him, the gym is filled with various weight machines, red accents, and bright fluorescent lighting. (3) The shot cuts to a medium-close perspective of the man as he continues the workout. He is now wearing his black hoodie open, revealing a black tank top with a purple graphic. He smiles at the camera, looking energetic and happy, while his hands continue to work the machine with rhythmic motions in the brightly lit space. (4) The exercise concludes, and the man is seen from the waist up. He reaches for a large olive-green backpack and a shaker bottle containing orange liquid placed on a bench. He puts the backpack on his shoulders and begins to walk away from the equipment, moving deeper into the gym environment past other black and red weight machines.
